lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Monday's Norwood Planning and Zoning meeting, where commissioners are set to formally adopt Phase I of a Land Use Code rewrite — the kind of decision that quietly shapes development for years to come. Telluride Town Council meets Monday and Tuesday with a full plate: a deed-restriction conversion at 215 East Colorado that would remove the price cap on two affordable units, plus public hearings on related ordinances. The County commissioners take up a continued public hearing on adopting updated international building codes and will hear a preview of 2027 nonprofit funding allocations.

notable.stake: Ordinance vote could rewrite Norwood's development rules for years ahead.
Board votes on state ballot measure resolutions and two board policy second readings.
Resolution would convert two affordable ownership units, removing their maximum sale price.
Public hearings and vote on converting deed-restricted affordable units at 215 E. Colorado.
Commission decides on leak check fee and six leak forgiveness requests affecting water bills.
Continued public hearing on new building codes plus 2027 nonprofit funding allocations.
